item.title: Actually, I Do Need Some Cheetos: Has Frito-Lay Broken the Code on Digital Impulse Buying?
item.description: The checkout line — and all the "stuff" — moves to the pickup lane. A newly issued U.S. patent outlines a system designed to prompt impulse purchases at curbside pickup lanes, drive-thrus, and fuel stations.

item.description: New institute will advance interdisciplinary research on how human senses shape perception, communication, and quality of life.

item.description: Reata Restaurant president to lead chamber in 2026 as organization launches new three-year strategic plan.

item.description: Crescent Real Estate promotes three senior leaders and adds a new hospitality executive as the firm continues to expand its portfolio in Dallas and beyond.

item.title: Young Adults Rethink Career Paths as Costs Rise

item.title: The Hidden Cash-Flow Risks of Buy Now, Pay Later Apps
